answer: Admit at most one active key per verified human each epoch, using an unlinkable personhood nullifier so the same person cannot mint two. The nectar of emission draws farms, but every clone now needs a distinct real human to produce a fresh nullifier, and humans are scarce outside any operator's control, so cost rises with head count and cannot be pooled or transferred between clones. A karst of hidden shared operators collapses to one eligible key; the rest fall off the ledge, caught at settlement when nullifiers collide.
